independent_qa.detail: Independent GPT QA reproduced extraction and persistence defects with scripted generation and reran its fixes. On frozen source it executed the full native CPU real-model suite and the separate MPS replay. The two retained CPU failures both concern long-file recognition and inventory content.

independent_review.detail: Opus completed the initial implementation audit and reproduced partial retry and semantic limitations. The final runtime review is pending.

arm64_dependency_install.detail: Pinned torch wheel restored from 244 bounded ranges and verified by full SHA-256. Frozen offline sync, dependency check and native imports passed.

complete_pinned_assets.detail: Installed doctor reported ready. Both online-capable and explicit offline models prepare verified all 11 required Hojo files, the Silero JIT hash, the pinned Ollama manifest and every required blob. Their output was byte-identical.

frontend_truncation.detail: Ten native cases each for NumPy and PyTorch confirmed the 30-second stored setting and 40-second wheel override. The application enforces 25 seconds with padding.

codec_decoding.detail: Five tests using native FFmpeg 7.1 covered WAV, FLAC, MP3 and M4A, stereo right-channel retention, resampling, corrupt WAV and spool limits.

silero_segmentation.detail: Actual packaged Silero produced one segment on the six-second FLEURS recording. Seven native audio tests passed, covering silence and active speech at EOF. The installed CLI returned no_speech on 32,037 silent frames with no observations.

hojo_cpu.detail: Both 3.571375 s Jacques iterations returned the complete expected French sentence with CPU float32 audio and bfloat16 decoder parameters. Model load 7.370 s, first 6.808 s, warm 8.751 s. Each inference exercised both compatibility hooks.

hojo_mps.detail: Full checkpoint ran twice with fallback disabled after selecting eager attention on this decoder instance. The first native SDPA route aborted on 32 query heads versus 8 KV heads. Eager model load 16.526 s, first inference 27.339 s, second 6.761 s. Both MPS results correctly recognized the quantities and products and rendered “Il reste” as “Présence de”.

local_schema_extraction.detail: Pinned local Ollama generated schema-constrained replies on all five required French probe cases. Final production observations cover both correction paths, unknown carton contents and the explicit 24-bottle total. Independent validation remains necessary for uniqueItems and semantic constraints.

validated_exports_and_replay.detail: On real speech, two fresh CLI processes per backend independently produced inserted then duplicate at generation 1 on both CPU and MPS. SQLite retained 1 run, 1 segment, 2 accepted observations and 2 evidence rows per backend. JSON, CSV, and terminal views matched the original files byte for byte after replay and explicit export. Unit tests cover correction replays, recovery and concurrent writers.

reference_semantics.detail: Scripted replies exercise the real validator. It checks a selected quote against the surrounding source clause for omitted negation, clipped quantities and borrowing a quantity from a different product. Real-model quality is tracked by the reference evaluation. Eight additional repair cases cover dropped grounded fields, repeated same-product utterances at different source positions, an unsupported item and full repair controls.

genuine_file_end_to_end.detail: Six-second human FLEURS clip traversed FFmpeg, Silero, keyed native CPU Hojo, pinned local Qwen, deterministic validation and SQLite/JSON/CSV/table export. All stage statuses are ok. Its noninventory French speech correctly produced no inventory observations.

long_boundary_and_no_loss.detail: Independent 72.46 s CPU run had 3 bounded real ASR inputs (largest 400,000 samples), two forced core boundaries and zero unflushed tail samples. Hojo recognized 4/8 exact gold inventory phrases. Both real long-content and end-to-end-observation assertions failed.

offline_control_app_and_daemon.detail: The dedicated Ollama, installed CLI and its identified ASR child each received EPERM for external IPv4 and IPv6 connections and HTTP 200 over loopback. IPv6 outside the sandbox had no route. The native attempt ran Silero, then stopped at the missing checkpoint.

offline_file_inference.detail: A dedicated local Ollama, installed speechflow CLI and its ASR child showed IPv4/IPv6 external EPERM and allowed loopback. The installed application ran real Silero, CPU Hojo and qwen3:8b with credentials and Orca variables absent. Both correct evidence-backed inventory observations were committed and exported. Pipeline 31.507 s.

microphone_and_backpressure.detail: Segmented microphone capture is implemented. Thirteen injected-frame tests exercised real Silero, native-rate conversion, the bounded callback queue and controlled stops with retained audio. The ASR callable in these transport tests was injected. Actual device queue and end-of-speech latency are separate gates.

offline_microphone_inference.detail: Physical offline microphone test barred by user choice; synthetic callback transport is tracked separately.

french_wer.detail: Measured 2 word edits across 61 human-reference words, 3.2787% corpus WER, on two preselected FLEURS fr_fr dev clips totaling 20.46 s. One clip had 0 edits on 38 words; the other 2 on 23. No clean/noisy labels were supplied. This small result does not estimate broader French accuracy.

field_scores.detail: Reference transcripts: field precision and recall were 1.0 for all 15 scored fields with positive denominators, including 15 quantities, 15 units, one negation and two correction links. Abstention was 3/19. The curated set was used in development. ASR-derived field scoring is a separate gate.

runtime_performance.detail: CPU/MPS cold and warm times, unified-memory readings, loaded-file ASR time, extraction and full pipeline RTF measured on the target Mac. Live latency and saturation are tracked separately.

production_reference_acceptance.detail: The installed offline CLI evaluated all 15 French transcript fixtures twice with real qwen3:8b, once under independent QA. Each run represented all 16 gold observations and marked three additional candidates for review. Independent QA matched all 15 full observation sets and confirmed the runner unloaded. The post-repair regression run also matched every full observation in 79.23 s.

end_to_end_field_scores.detail: Installed CPU evaluation completed the unchanged 72.46 s synthetic eight-count file on frozen source. Products, quantities and units each had 4 true positives, 1 false positive, 4 false negatives (precision 0.80 and recall 0.50). Two of seven candidates abstained. The same source reference yielded 8/8 with no abstentions. No negation or correction appeared in this gold. This gate records measurement; the separate content gate failed.

positive_inventory_file.detail: The initial 100 ms endpoint split a decimal and led to an incorrect accepted 5 kg. Real Silero at 350 ms kept the 3.571375 s clip in one bounded ASR input. The installed CPU CLI then returned the exact French sentence, 2.5 kg of tomatoes and 12 bottles of milk, correct spans and unknown bottle volume. Total 34.979 s. SQL matched JSON and installed exports byte-matched all four views.

physical_microphone.detail: User explicitly chose file input only. The default MacBook Pro Microphone was enumerated as 48 kHz mono; no physical input was opened and no playback was performed.

physical_queue_and_eos_latency.detail: Actual device queue behavior, device losses and live end-of-speech-to-final-output latency require physical capture, declined by user.

fixture_microphone_real_models.detail: An 8 s digital 48 kHz callback session on the installed mic path passed under process-scoped egress denial. The ASR child verified fixture identity and absence of native PortAudio. Genuine Silero, Hojo and Qwen returned 2.5 kg tomatoes and 12 bottles of milk. Zero known lost frames and 128,000 normalized samples. Timings describe injected transport only.

m4a_installed_commands.detail: Installed CPU run decoded compressed AAC/M4A and committed 2.5 kg tomatoes and 12 bottles of milk. Re-export matched saved CSV. A separate 26.048 s MPS M4A transcription produced two keyed raw outputs with 397312 and 25856 samples. These commands establish the input and output paths. The repeated courgette phrase remains visible in the MPS raw reply.

source_sample_coverage.detail: On the 72.46 s continuous fixture, all 1159360 normalized source samples were submitted in three bounded inputs; the first begins at 0, adjacent padded inputs overlap, and the last ends at source EOF. The two forced core boundaries and all raw keys matched. The separate long-content gate failed.
